page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.cm4.4xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2667 v4 processor running at 3.2 GHz. Built on the x86_64 architecture under a KVM hypervisor, this instance features 16 dedicated physical cores with 1.0 thread per core. It is configured with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. The instance does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and it offers a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates average multi-core performance, with a stress-ng multi-core score of 11469.52 and a PassMark CPU score of 14861.27. However, single-core performance is relatively weak, as shown by a stress-ng single-core score of 1150.39. Memory bandwidth tests show average read performance at 54.29 GB/sec for large blocks, but write performance for large blocks is weak at 24.73 GB/sec. The instance handles lighter computational tasks well, achieving average scores in gzip compression and bzip3 decompression.

Given its balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and average database operation benchmarks of 5002.27 on PassMark, the ecs.cm4.4xlarge is suited for general-purpose workloads, static web serving, and moderate database operations. It handles small-scale LLM inference using a 135M model at average speeds, but performance drops to weak levels for medium-sized 7B models. The lack of local storage requires external block storage attachment, which should be factored into the overall resource architecture.
